title: Plato's Atlantis located in Antarctica

tellings.quote: >> Well we have a world ocean. It's where the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean meet. >> Sure. >> In the coastline of Antarctica.

related.note: Same subject (where Plato's Atlantis was) but places it in Antarctica rather than on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a competing claim.

plain: The lost island of Atlantis, which the ancient Greek philosopher Plato described in his dialogues Timaeus and Critias, lay off the coast of Antarctica, according to a researcher named Jason Jorjani. He reads Plato's "world ocean" as the spot where the Pacific, Atlantic and Indian Oceans meet, which is along the Antarctic coastline. He gives this as his own reading of Plato and does not cite anyone else for it.
